description: Add a labelled frame (a region such as Week 1 or Hooks) to a board. To wrap existing cards in a frame use group_cards instead. Costs no credits. SIGN-IN REQUIRED: connect this server with OAuth (the host prompts for it), or add an API key header "Authorization: Bearer acd_live_…" created at https://aicontentdrop.com/settings/integrations.

canvas_id.description: The board id, from list_canvases or create_canvas.

height.description: Optional height in pixels; defaults to 360.

label.description: The frame's label, up to 200 characters.

position.description: Optional { x, y } in board pixels. When omitted the server places the card in the first free grid cell.

revision.description: The board revision this change is based on (from the last board you saw). Optional: when omitted the tool reads the current one first.

width.description: Optional width in pixels; defaults to 480.

name: add_frame

data.description: Per type. text: { text, title?, color? }. media: { url, kind, title?, caption?, source? }. generation: { model?, prompt?, kind, status (draft | queued | generating | done | failed), job_id?, media_url?, credits_used?, error? }. frame: { label, width, height }. task: { taskId }.

items.description: A connection drawn from one card to the next: { id, source, target, label? }. data.role start_image means the source card's finished image is the target card's start frame.

label.description: Text drawn on the line, when it has one.

source.description: The card the connection starts from.

link.description: The board's page on AI Content Drop.

revision.description: The board's version; every write bumps it.
